Title: Vinod's Day

Cast

1. Vinod - 36 years, son
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
2. Meenakshi - 65 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Nitin - 64 years, father
Look: glasses, brown sweater
4. Anjali - 31 years, friend
Look: red salwar-kameez

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The road - a paved road, trees along it

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Vinod stands in the living room. Meenakshi and Nitin stand near him.]

Meenakshi: "What lovely weather!"

[Vinod pours himself a whisky and drinks it.]

Meenakshi (happily): "That's easy."

[Vinod sips red wine.]

Vinod: "Well done!"

[Vinod drinks a beer.]

Vinod: "Okay, Mom."

[Vinod staggers drunkenly towards the door.]

Nitin (excited): "One more time!"

[Vinod and Mother clink their glasses.]

Vinod: "Mom, look at this."

Scene 2: The road - Day

Nitin: "So, here we are!"

[Vinod drives the car to the office.]

Vinod: "What next?"

[Vinod rides the scooter with Mother sitting behind him.]

Meenakshi (happily): "Oh wow!"

[Vinod takes Mother to the market on his motorbike, she sits behind him.]

Vinod: "What a day to remember!"
